name: MIP Scale Computation
definition: Computes a per-Gaussian scale factor based on camera distance and focal length, typically used for anti-aliasing or level-of-detail adjustments in Gaussian splatting.
summary: MIP Scale Computation calculates per-Gaussian scale factors from camera distance and focal length for anti-aliasing, differing from standard methods by operating on parametric Gaussian primitives rather than volumetric voxels.
